description_en: Queries the task nodes of a task flow instance
description_zh: 调用GetTaskInstanceRelation接口，获取任务流运行记录的节点信息
name: GetTaskInstanceRelation

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to obtain the ID of the task flow
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the execution record of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424689.html operation to obtain the execution record ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务流运行记录ID（Id），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424689.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request fails

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request fails

Node.description_en: The information about the nodes in the execution record of the task flow
Node.description_zh: 任务流运行记录的节点信息列表

items.description_zh: 运行记录的节点信息列表

BusinessTime.description_en: The business time of the node

EndTime.description_en: The time when the execution of the task flow was complete. The time is displayed in the yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
EndTime.description_zh: 任务流运行结束时间，时间格式为yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

ExecuteTime.description_en: The amount of time consumed for running the node. Unit: milliseconds
ExecuteTime.description_zh: 任务执行时间，单位为毫秒

Id.description_en: The ID of the execution record of the task flow

NodeType.description_en: The type of the node. For more information about the valid values for this parameter, see [NodeType parameter]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424705.html）
NodeType.description_zh: 任务节点类型，返回值请参见[NodeType参数说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424705.html）

Status.description_en:
The status of the node. Valid values:

0: The node is waiting to be scheduled.
1: The node is running.
2: The node is suspended.
3: The node failed to run.
4: The node is run.
5: The node is complete
Status.description_zh:
任务节点运行状态，取值如下：
0：等待调度
1：正在运行
2：挂起
3：运行失败
4：运行成功
5：已完成

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
